# NovintiX
> The MedTech Lifecycle Partner — AI-readable site manifest

NovintiX (novintix.com) is a MedTech lifecycle services company founded in 2023 by industry veterans.
Services: Product Engineering & Discovery, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Quality & Regulatory Compliance, Clinical Affairs, Digital & AI.
AI Product: ProofX — AI-native V&V test-proof system of record for regulated medical devices and SaMD.
Global hubs: Exton PA (US HQ) · Dublin (EU Regulatory Gateway) · Coimbatore (APAC Engineering Hub).
~100 specialists, 150+ years combined MedTech leadership, 5.0/5 Indeed rating.
